claims.content: Enable the customer to select won items, choose a shipping method, and complete payment via PayPal or Amazon within the required timeframe.

goal.raw_text: Enable the customer to select won items, choose a shipping method, and complete payment via PayPal or Amazon within the required timeframe.

claims.content: Customer
The customer has won one or more auctions.
The customer has PayPal or Amazon Payments set as their default Method of Payment (MOP) in their registration information.
The customer has unpaid auction winnings.
The current time is within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time.
The customer clicks on the "Winnings Alert" link provided in the winner notification email or displayed as a text bar on the website.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks on the "Winnings Alert" link provided in the winner notification email or displayed as a text bar on the website.

claims.content: The customer clicks on the "Winnings Alert" link or text bar to access the "Returning Winners Payments" page.
On the "Returning Winners Payments" page, the customer selects the specific won items they wish to pay for by checking the "Pay Now" box next to each item.
The customer chooses a shipping method (e.g., USPS Standard or Expedited) via radio buttons.
The customer selects a checkout option by clicking the radio button/logo for PayPal, Amazon Payments, or "Checkout Later".
If PayPal is selected, the customer is redirected to the PayPal-hosted checkout page to complete the transaction.
If Amazon Payments is selected, the Amazon Payments checkout widget loads on the page for the customer to complete the transaction.
Upon successful completion of the payment process, the customer is returned to a Thank You page.
The customer may choose to defer payment by selecting the 'Checkout Later' option instead of PayPal or Amazon Payments.
If the customer fails to complete the transaction within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time, the order will be cancelled and the item placed into a 'Hold' status.

If the customer fails to complete the transaction within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time, the order will be cancelled, the item placed into a 'Hold' status, and the user's account may be suspended.
When selecting 'Checkout Later', the system displays a warning that unpaid orders will be cancelled after the 7-day payment window expires.
The customer is returned to a Thank You page, which includes the global header and footer, and a prominent link to the JTVauctions.com home page.
